question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "academic_terms" AS SELECT term_code, TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM beaver.academic_terms
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_offered_summary" AS SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, responsible_faculty_name FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "course_catalog_subject_offered" AS SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, subject_short_title, subject_number, subject_code, grade_type, grade_type_desc, lecture_units, lab_units, preparation_units, total_units, design_units, hgn_code, hgn_desc FROM beaver.course_catalog_subject_offered
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_offered_summary" AS SELECT TERM_CODE AS term_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "course_catalog_subject_offered" AS SELECT TERM_CODE AS term_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title, SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE AS subject_short_title, SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_number, SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, GRADE_TYPE_DESC AS grade_type_desc, LECTURE_UNITS AS lecture_units, LAB_UNITS AS lab_units, PREPARATION_UNITS AS preparation_units, TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units, DESIGN_UNITS AS design_units, HGN_CODE AS hgn_code, HGN_DESC AS hgn_desc FROM beaver.course_catalog_subject_offered

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE per_subject_2023fa AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT sos.term_code,
         sos.subject_id,
         sos.subject_title AS subject_title_instr,
         sos.responsible_faculty_name AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered_summary sos
  WHERE sos.term_code = '2023FA'
), cat AS (
  SELECT c.term_code,
         c.subject_id,
         c.subject_title AS subject_title_cat,
         c.subject_code,
         c.subject_number,
         c.hgn_code,
         c.hgn_desc
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE c.term_code = '2023FA'
), joined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(base.term_code, cat.term_code) AS term_code,
         COALESCE(base.subject_id, cat.subject_id) AS subject_id,
         COALESCE(base.subject_title_instr, cat.subject_title_cat) AS subject_title,
         base.instructor,
         cat.subject_code,
         cat.subject_number,
         cat.hgn_code,
         cat.hgn_desc
  FROM base
  FULL OUTER JOIN cat
    ON base.term_code = cat.term_code AND base.subject_id = cat.subject_id
)
SELECT j.term_code,
       j.subject_id,
       j.subject_title,
       j.instructor,
       j.subject_code,
       j.subject_number,
       j.hgn_code,
       j.hgn_desc
FROM joined j;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_subject_counts AS
SELECT term_code, COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS total_subject_types
FROM per_subject_2023fa
GROUP BY term_code;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE instructor_breadth AS
SELECT responsible_faculty_name AS instructor,
       COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS instructor_distinct_subject_types_ever
FROM subject_offered_summary
WHERE responsible_faculty_name IS NOT NULL AND responsible_faculty_name <> ''
GROUP BY responsible_faculty_name;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT td.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
       ps.term_code,
       ps.subject_id,
       ps.subject_title,
       ps.hgn_desc AS prerequisites_proxy,
       ps.instructor,
       ib.instructor_distinct_subject_types_ever,
       asc.total_subject_types AS total_subject_types_per_term
FROM per_subject_2023fa ps
LEFT JOIN term_2023fa_desc td ON td.term_code = ps.term_code
LEFT JOIN agg_subject_counts asc ON asc.term_code = ps.term_code
LEFT JOIN instructor_breadth ib ON ib.instructor = ps.instructor
WHERE ps.term_code = '2023FA'
ORDER BY ps.subject_code, ps.subject_number

# Produce unique term descriptions and subjects with prerequisites proxy, instructor, subject-type counts per term, and instructor course-type breadth for Fall 2023.
from typing import List

term = '2023FA'

per_subject_sql = f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE per_subject_2023fa AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT sos.term_code,
         sos.subject_id,
         sos.subject_title AS subject_title_instr,
         sos.responsible_faculty_name AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered_summary sos
  WHERE sos.term_code = '{term}'
), cat AS (
  SELECT c.term_code,
         c.subject_id,
         c.subject_title AS subject_title_cat,
         c.subject_code,
         c.subject_number,
         c.hgn_code,
         c.hgn_desc
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE c.term_code = '{term}'
), joined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(base.term_code, cat.term_code) AS term_code,
         COALESCE(base.subject_id, cat.subject_id) AS subject_id,
         COALESCE(base.subject_title_instr, cat.subject_title_cat) AS subject_title,
         base.instructor,
         cat.subject_code,
         cat.subject_number,
         cat.hgn_code,
         cat.hgn_desc
  FROM base
  FULL OUTER JOIN cat
    ON base.term_code = cat.term_code AND base.subject_id = cat.subject_id
)
SELECT j.term_code,
       j.subject_id,
       j.subject_title,
       j.instructor,
       j.subject_code,
       j.subject_number,
       j.hgn_code,
       j.hgn_desc
FROM joined j;
"""
